name: Muraganda
description: A primordial plane rich with life and raw magic, inhabited by dinosaurs and oozes, with unstable moons.

timeline.summary: A plane-spanning civilization of Muraganda discovered magic and then collapsed, its moons shattering.
timeline.quote: The plane's moons shattered to pieces, and debris still falls onto the plane to this day.

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opens, making Muraganda's wilds part of the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: a stable Omenpath from Amonkhet opened up on Muraganda

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Avishkari advance teams deploy and find the treaties secured with the Saurid Autocracy were not signed with the full knowledge of other inhabitants.
timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Second Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Muraganda is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion, but the Phyrexians cannot overcome the dinosaurs and oozes.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians were unable to overcome the dinosaurs and the immortal hunger of the plane's oozes .

citation.text: "Muraganda", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.
timeline.quote: Up ahead, an Omenpath ripples at the end of the track.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire is awed by Muraganda's giant flowers and suspended rain.
timeline.quote: No amount of daydreaming could have prepared her for Muraganda.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees Pia talking to the dead Champion who has been raised.
timeline.quote: Her attention is focused on a member of the Champions: a dark-skinned man with gold-adorned dreadlocks.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia explains that Khuru is the first raised in the race after giving his life for Zahur.
timeline.quote: That young man, Khuru, is the first one they've raised during this race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Grennar mocks Vin's claim that the islands float.
timeline.quote: They're falling,

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Grennar hurls Vin's camera at the river above.
timeline.quote: hurls the camera as hard as he can toward the river up above.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra races through giant oaks that crash down onto the course.
timeline.quote: Towering oaks reach up to a sky glittering with stars, only to come crashing down right onto them.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra slips past two Voyagers who crash into a wheel hub.
timeline.quote: The wanderers smack straight into the wheel hubs without any time to adjust

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra hurls a fireball that burns a tunnel through a falling tree.
timeline.quote: She hurls the fireball at the oncoming tree.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Emerging in first, Chandra sees Winter ahead of her again.
timeline.quote: Winter is somehow right up ahead of her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire waits for the Amonkheti to cut through a tree rather than use Chandra's tunnel.
timeline.quote: she throws the ride into reverse and waits for the Amonkheti to slice through the tree.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees the raised Khuru riding with Basri and Zahur.
timeline.quote: the man who died saving Zahur only yesterday

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A moonfall quake begins and the Amonkheti chariot hippo bolts for shelter.
timeline.quote: Sure enough, the gentle tremble beneath them intensifies into a hungry growl from the earth.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia orders Spitfire to pull into the valley and Spitfire obeys.
timeline.quote: She turns toward the valley.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A pit opens under Mincemeat and the Endriders; she lands in Fortune's trunk.
timeline.quote: A yawning pit opens beneath her, one large enough to swallow Mincemeat and the five riders around her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A giant dinosaur carrying a fortress and a dozen mounted lizardman raiders attack the trapped racers.
timeline.quote: There's a ramshackle fortress on its back comprised of three levels of wood and lizardmen.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti's goblins charge the beast but run into a snare net and raiders capture them.
timeline.quote: He can see it now: the net holding them aloft and the glowing, reptilian eyes of their captors.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Redshift and the goblins bail out of the trapped vehicle, abandoning Daretti.
timeline.quote: Bye, Boss! Real nice working with you!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra senses a hidden dinosaur and slides away from its leap.
timeline.quote: Chandra spots the spiny crown of a dinosaur hiding in a pit the instant before he leaps toward them.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A raider's hook tears Loot's cage from Winter's vehicle and drops Loot into a sack.
timeline.quote: Momentum and angles combine to tear the hook free—and the cage along with it.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra abandons the race and jumps onto a dinosaur to rescue Loot.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar jumps from her ride and hitches a ride on one that's more old-fashioned.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire injects aether and slips through the raiders and dinosaur to take the lead.
timeline.quote: She jams another canister of aether into the port on the suit's shoulder and twists.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra's ride is crushed by a dinosaur and Spitfire sees her clinging to a raptor.
timeline.quote: The younger Nalaar's ride is crushed underfoot by a rampaging dinosaur.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire switches off her radio and leaves Chandra behind.
timeline.quote: With a flick of a switch, Spitfire switches off her radio.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti is caged with Loot and introduces himself.
timeline.quote: The name's Daretti.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Daretti shares Fioran chocolate with Loot as they expect to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: If we're going to be sacrificed the way they say, at least we'll go out like gentlemen

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Loot spots a sneaking Chandra in Cloudspire colors.
timeline.quote: Slinking among the foliage, he sees a slip of orange-red fire

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia crumbles a raider as he finds Chandra hiding in Daretti's vehicle.
timeline.quote: the raider ends up crumbling to the ground like a stack of pebbles.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia picks the cage lock and frees Loot and Daretti.
timeline.quote: And, sure enough, Chandra's mom has the lock figured out all before Daretti has even realized there's anything going on behind him.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Loot a place with Team Cloudspire.
timeline.quote: If you like, you can hang out with me and Team Cloudspire.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra sets off a fireball that blows up half the raiders' camp as they escape.
timeline.quote: As half of the camp explodes, she hops into the ride with the others.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Following Loot's cue, Chandra steers left into a tree whose bark falls away to reveal an Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, the spiraling light of an Omenpath.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: They crash across the border into a different world.
timeline.quote: A second later, they crash over the border into a different world.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad and Grazak leap into a devastated clearing full of wrecked metal.
timeline.quote: Khrad roared and leapt into the clearing, Star-Sword brandished overhead.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Masked raiders burst from the slag and attack Khrad and Grazak.
timeline.quote: A mob of bug-eyed figures swarmed from underneath the slag like maggots bursting from a ripened corpse.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad halves a giant's club with the Star-Sword.
timeline.quote: Khrad halved the weapon with a mighty blow, showering them both in sparks.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad feeds Grazak a mana pearl, making him giant.
timeline.quote: Grazak's form expanded—doubling, then tripling.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad kills a smoke-spitting marauder mage by feel after being blinded.
timeline.quote: The Star-Sword found the mage's throat.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Grazak finds two deep grooves leading away from the clearing.
timeline.quote: two grooves a handsbreadth across and a stride apart, dug into the jungle floor

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad feeds Grazak the second pearl and rides him after the shouting Amarth-Tel.
timeline.quote: Khrad pulled the second mana pearl from his pouch and fed it to Grazak.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad finds Amarth-Tel standing on a steel-and-fire beast pulled by a tar ooze.
timeline.quote: Amarth-Tel, wrapped in oily vestments, stood atop a beast of steel and fire, dragged forth by a massive tar-black ooze.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad sees a shackled girl in the vehicle's hollow and is distracted.
timeline.quote: She sat shackled in the creature's hollow, bound in Amarth-Tel's tarry cord.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Amarth-Tel's ooze flings Khrad away and the beast escapes.
timeline.quote: A lashing oily tendril surged and sent the prince aloft.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The Fang Druid Chatal appears and urges Khrad to continue against Amarth-Tel.
timeline.quote: I am called Chatal.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chatal tells Khrad that the world is larger than he realizes and urges him to reforge himself.
timeline.quote: The world is larger than you realize, Prince of Telu.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chatal gives Khrad a fire amulet that grants mastery over the vehicle.
timeline.quote: If used correctly, it will grant mastery over the beast, allowing communion between machine and man.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nathala throws Khrad's earlier words back at him, telling him to flee home.
timeline.quote: Use this opportunity to flee back to your home.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Khrad humbly apologizes for his arrogance and asks to learn about the vehicle.
timeline.quote: I have been a fool.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nathala lets Khrad tag along on condition that she drives.
timeline.quote: All right. You can tag along, on one condition.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: The three drive off into the horizon together.
timeline.quote: Together, paragons of Muraganda, they drove into the infinite horizon.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Caelorna emerges from the water, bringing her coral depths with her.
timeline.quote: When she emerged, the coral depths she called home came with her.

citation.text: Caelorna, Coral Tyrant (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers use Daretti as a decoy; he is taken to a saurid village and imprisoned with Loot to be sacrificed.
timeline.quote: He was taken to a saurid village and imprisoned alongside Loot to be offered as a sacrifice.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Pia Nalaar rescue Daretti and Loot; Daretti patches his car and Chandra drives it away.
timeline.quote: Daretti quickly patched together his car, and Chandra drove it away from the village.

citation.text: "Daretti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The race crosses Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers are hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.
timeline.quote: Their progress was also hindered by attacks from giant dinosaur and Saurid raiders.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani recruit Garruk on Muraganda to help stop Jace's plot to erase the Multiverse.
timeline.quote: Garruk agreed to help

citation.text: "Garruk", section "Reality Fracture". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Ajani find Garruk's lodge on Muraganda, guarded by tripwires, and he leads them in.
timeline.quote: This tower of muscles can only be Garruk Wildspeaker.

citation.work: Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both
citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

timeline.summary: The Rocketeers lead the first three legs but are first to cross a trap laid by saurid raiders in Muraganda.
timeline.quote: they were the first to cross a trap laid on the course by saurid raiders

citation.text: "Goblin Rocketeers", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Khrad catches Amarth-Tel riding the beast with a captive and is easily defeated.
timeline.quote: However, he was easily defeated by the ley mage.

citation.text: "Khrad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Chatal tells Khrad the beast is a vehicle and gives him an artifact to control it.
timeline.quote: who told him that the beast was called a vehicle

citation.text: "Khrad", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the race.
timeline.quote: Advance teams from Avishkar were deployed to Muraganda a year before the beginning of the race

citation.text: "Saurid Autocracy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Autocracy used its agreements with Avishkar to advance its borders and claim to speak for the plane.
timeline.quote: assured themselves the prime position of "speaking" for the plane.

citation.text: "Saurid Autocracy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: Muraganda 's most frequently-seen apes are the gorilla members of the Fang Druids

citation.text: "Ape", section "Muraganda". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Muraganda", section "Factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Muraganda", section "Known locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

relations.quote: The Saurid Autocracy is the mightiest state on the plane of Muraganda .

citation.text: "Saurid Autocracy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

pages_say.description: A valley overtaken by an ancient force.

citation.text: Future Sight: card flavor text (Future Sight, 2007), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A plane with a steaming primordial jungle suited to enormous reptilian beasts.

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.
"Fifteen Commanders, Fifteen Tales". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Jun 2011. Archived by the Internet Archive.

pages_say.description: A lush plane of giant flowers and floating boulders where the racers camp.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A plane of giant falling trees, moonfalls and floating rivers where the third leg takes place.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A plane of teeming life, leylines and tectonic wrath.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Like No Other Beast" by Zachary Olson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

pages_say.description: A jungle plane under falling moonfalls and home to the Fang Druids.

citation.text: Aetherdrift: card flavor text (Aetherdrift, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: A jungle plane where Garruk lives.

citation.text: "Reality Fracture | Episode 3: I Can Be Both" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Sep 2026.

citation.text: "Daretti". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
